description: The file defines interfaces and constants for low-level internal ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) operations in a firmware project, including function prototypes for ADC initialization, data retrieval, and conversion, as well as relevant macros and data structures.

classes.name: adc_state
classes.description: Structure representing a snapshot of multi-channel ADC data with a volatile array holding ADC samples.

methods.name: getAdcMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the specified ADC hardware channel.

methods.name: initAdcInputs
methods.description: Initializes ADC input subsystem, optionally in test mode.

methods.name: adc_callback_fast
methods.description: Fast callback function for ADC data handling.

methods.name: getAdcChannelPin
methods.description: Deprecated: Retrieves the pin associated with a hardware ADC channel.

methods.name: getAdcChannelPort
methods.description: Deprecated: Gets the port ID for a specified ADC channel.

methods.name: getAdcChannel
methods.description: Returns the ADC channel corresponding to a specified brain pin.

methods.name: getAdcChannelBrainPin
methods.description: Returns the brain pin associated with a given ADC channel.

methods.name: waitForSlowAdc
methods.description: Blocks until at least one slow ADC sampling is complete.

methods.name: getSlowAdcCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of completed slow ADC samples.

methods.name: getAdcHardwareIndexByInternalIndex
methods.description: Maps an internal index to the corresponding hardware ADC index.

methods.name: printFullAdcReportIfNeeded
methods.description: Prints a full ADC report if required.

methods.name: getInternalAdcValue
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ADC value with an optional message context.

methods.name: getMCUInternalTemperature
methods.description: Reads the internal temperature of the MCU.

methods.name: adcToVoltsDivided
methods.description: Converts ADC reading to voltage, accounting for the input divider coefficient.
